pages.title: Weather Display
pages.text: A desk display in a wood case. Within 64 blocks of a $(l:radiocraft:sky/weather_station)Local Weather Station$() its red LCD steps through the temperature (°F), humidity, pressure (inHg), wind direction and speed, gusts and rain in the last hour.
It needs no power. With no station in range it shows dashes and NO STATION.$(br2)Right click it for every reading at once.
